disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SD, range and median of 23 elements in 30 potato and corn chip samples from the Jordanian market, and Table 2 prints means by origin (imported, local) and type (corn, potato).

study.design: Market survey of acrylamide and 23 elements with health risk index
study.origin: Locally produced in Jordan or imported (Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Germany, Spain, Turkey named as source countries for chips sold in Jordan)
study.market: Local samples obtained from commercial producers; imported samples bought in local markets; conclusion says Civil Service Consumer Corporation markets, Jordan
study.method: Microwave digestion (HNO3/H2O2, 200 C), ICP-MS (Agilent 7500a); external calibration
lod: Instrument LODs 0.056-3.45 ug/L for potentially toxic elements (Tl to As), 0.008-4.21 ug/L for trace elements, 1.46 ug/L Mg, 1.53 ug/L Ca; per-element values in Table S3 (not in PDF)
study.qa: Calibration r > 0.999; precision (RSD of slope) mostly <5%; no certified reference material or recovery reported

findings.notes: Table 1 is titled 'honey samples' in the PDF, a caption error; content is chips. Text gives Mg mean as 591 mg/kg.

controls.control: Product origin: local production vs imported
controls.outcome: Local chips (n = 12): Pb 0.26 vs 0.15 mg/kg (p 0.71), Cd 0.063 vs 0.056 mg/kg (p 0.25), As 0.025 vs 0.036 mg/kg (p 0.17); no significant difference for the toxic elements; Ca and Ni significantly higher in local chips

controls.control: Product type: corn chips vs potato chips

unresolved: Sampling text describes all 30 samples as potato chips (12 local from producers, 18 imported from markets), but Tables 2 and the text split them 15 corn and 15 potato; how corn and potato samples map to local and imported is in Table S1, which is not in the PDF.
Lead text (32-4870 ug/kg, mean 334, CV 260%) conflicts with Table 1 (32-870, mean 201, CV 104%); Table 1 recorded with integrity flags.
Table 1 caption says 'honey samples', and the text says strontium could distinguish local and imported 'honey'; copy-over errors from another paper.
Methods say triplicate digestion; table footnotes say four replicates.
Per-element LOD/LOQ (Table S3) and per-sample results (Table S1) are supplementary and not available next to the PDF.
Acrylamide results (3.93 ± 1.50 mg/kg) are not metals and are not recorded as findings.
